title: Tensor, composition and adjunction coefficient squares on short words
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ work on their small pro-etale sites and put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W$ be the actual reduction/total-limit adjunction on ordinary derived categories of strict semilinear module systems, with unit $u$ and counit $e$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], using the simultaneous section constructions [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. System operations are exact inverse image $P_v$, derived direct image $S_v$ with $P_v\dashv S_v$, exact open extension $J_j\dashv P_j$, and derived tensor. All maps $v$ are separated finite type; maps denoted $p$ are proper and opens $j$ are quasi-compact [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Integral operations $A_{\rm int}$ are completed pullback and tensor, proper direct image, and localized completed-ring open extension [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-derived-direct-image, lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Inputs $K_i$ are derived-complete constructible integral complexes. Every input and intermediate system occurring in the assertion is normalized, has compatible etale-origin witnesses and constructible cohomology, and has cohomological and finite Tor amplitudes in common finite intervals [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

For a basic operation $A$ write $d_A:\mathcal L A(\mathcal R K_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_{\rm int}(K_i)$ for its defining strict reduction-tower identification, with two inputs for tensor and with $d_j$ fixed by [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Write $r_A:\mathcal R A_{\rm int}(K_i)\to A(\mathcal R K_i)$ for the canonical coefficient comparison of [lem-fix-operation-reduction], using the specified $r_j$ for open extension. These maps and the canonical completed ringed-site structural maps are fixed independently, through the section-normalized constructions [def-sf-integral-system-operations, def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge].

For a finite typed word $B$ in these operations, write $B_{\rm int}(K_i)$ and $B(\mathcal R K_i)$ for its two evaluations. Define $r_B:\mathcal R B_{\rm int}(K_i)\to B(\mathcal R K_i)$ recursively: at a variable it is the identity, at a unary vertex $A$ it is $A(r_{\rm child})\circ r_A$, and at a tensor vertex it is $(r_{\rm left}\otimes r_{\rm right})\circ r_\otimes$. Coefficient unit objects have their canonical scalar-unit identification. These are finite words in the typed domain [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], with no compact-support constructor.

Assume, for each basic operation applied to every integral intermediate in the words below, the primitive transpose equality $r_A=e_{A(\mathcal R K_i)}\circ\mathcal R(d_A^{-1})$. Let $\tau:B\to C$ be one tensor associator or left/right scalar-unit identification, a pullback compositor, a unit or counit of $P_v\dashv S_v$ or $J_j\dashv P_j$, or a direct-image compositor. Its endpoints have at most three operation vertices, tensor counting as one binary vertex. Let $\tau_{\rm int}$ be the corresponding canonical completed ringed-site map, with direct-image compositor the right-adjoint mate of the pullback compositor. Use the canonical ringed pullback/tensor/square identifications [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence]. Then
$$\tau_{\mathcal R K_i}\circ r_B=r_C\circ\mathcal R(\tau_{\rm int}).$$
This includes both directions of each invertible tensor or composition identification. The assertion is an equality in the derived category of whole semilinear systems, natural in the integral inputs, with all quotient transitions. It identifies the independently specified completed maps with the maps induced from the simultaneous system constructions, rather than defining the completed structural maps by this equality. It asserts only these structural generators on the stated short-word domain.

proof.text: Define the ordinary word comparison q from the tensor reduction, the canonical pullback comparison, its proper right mate and inverse open mate. Induction shows R(completionMap_B) followed by r_B equals q_B. Tensor and pullback use the inverse completion factors in r; proper image uses the conjugate-mate counit formula and the two triangle identities; open extension uses naturality of the inverse mate. The independent short-word completion helper supplies invertibility of completionMap_B. Hence canceling its reduction reduces the target to the ordinary comparison square.

proof.text: For a tensor associator, apply the reduction compatibility with internal-Hom composition at identity morphisms, and uncurry. The resulting equation is precisely preservation of associativity by the specified tensor reduction. Tensor naturality inserts q at all three children. The given scalar-unit normalization gives preservation of the left unitor. Preservation of the right unitor follows from associativity, the left-unit equation, tensor naturality and the triangle identity; cancel the tensor comparison and the scalar-unit isomorphism. Transport along ringed.tensorClosed gives the specified ringed constraints.

proof.text: The canonical whole-system reduction/pullback composition equation gives the ordinary pullback-compositor square; naturality inserts q at the child. Invert this compatibility square and apply Mathlib mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp, conjugateEquiv_mateEquiv_vcomp and mateEquiv_hcomp. The result is exactly the ordinary proper direct-image compositor square because both recorded direct-image compositors are the corresponding conjugates.

proof.text: For proper unit and counit use Mathlib unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv_counit for the canonical pullback comparison and its right mate. The fixed proper realization agrees with this mate after reconstruction by the conjugate formula. For the open adjunction use the inverse mate identities. At the required objects its open mate is invertible: the assumed primitive formulas and normalized reconstruction prove r_B invertible by induction, the completion helper then proves q_B invertible, and q_open = inverseOrZero(openReduction) followed by open(q_child) forces openReduction invertible. This uses only the stated normalized intermediates.

proof.text: Cancel reduction of the short-word completion transport to obtain Assertion. The tensor and composition generators are isomorphisms on both sides, so multiply the forward square by their inverses to obtain the reverse square. Recursive r is natural by induction: tensor and pullback use naturality of their comparisons together with the fact that primitive formulas make the required inverse completion comparisons invertible; proper image uses counit naturality; open uses the same local inverse-mate argument. Combining this with naturality of the system associator, unitors, compositors, units and counits proves the last conjunct. All equations are in the category of whole systems.
